summary: Master the art of Knowledge Capture and Codification. Join our course to discover effective techniques for reusing knowledge and driving innovation.
lede: Knowledge capture and reuse helps teams turn expertise and experience into guidance that can be found and applied again. It is designed for knowledge, operations, project, HR and learning professionals who need to document processes, retain lessons and reduce repeated work. Participants practice identifying knowledge holders, using interviews and after-action reviews to capture insights, shaping them into checklists or standard operating procedures, and organizing repositories so teams can retrieve and update what they need.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals who handle knowledge, operations, and performance, including:
audience: NGO program staff and M&E teams
modules: Foundations of Knowledge Capture and Reuse
Tools and Platforms for Knowledge Management
